Alex: Heads up — GreenMarket asked for a 4–6 week POC to validate our retrieval-augmented assistant for merchant support. They want EU-only residency, low latency, and a clear pricing comparison between Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Can we align success criteria and a recommended hosting path?
Morgan: Quick thoughts — if they need EU-only data residency but are OK with shared control plane, start Hosted in eu-west with model pinning + audit logs. If they require customer-managed network (VPC) or on-prem, Dedicated or Private.
Sam (AE): Pricing note: for Dedicated they usually need a minimum committed pool (ballpark: low-5-figs/month), and lead time for capacity is ~2–3 weeks. Hosted POC is fastest to start and cheaper short-term.
Jordan (Security): Questionnaire flags: will need answers for data residency, encryption at rest/in-transit, KMS integration, SOC2, and audit log retention. If GreenMarket insists on contractual DPAs and data processing in EU only, Dedicated in an EU region or Private is safer. Also ask whether PHI/PII is involved.
Rita (Solutions): For success criteria propose: 1) Quality: >= 90% accuracy on 1k evaluation prompts (customer-labeled dev set). 2) Performance: p95 latency < 200ms for 256-token responses on eu-west region. 3) Reliability: sustained throughput 200 RPS with <=1% error rate. 4) Security: pass security questionnaire items marked as "blocker" by legal.
Alex: Good list. Can we break down the hosting tradeoffs for their decision doc? I can draft a 1-pager. Key items: time-to-POC, data residency, network controls, SLA, cost delta, and rollback/fallback plan.
Morgan: Draft outline — (a) Quick MVP: Hosted eu-west, pinned model, eval harness, sample prompts; (b) Scale/Prod: Dedicated EU pool with private networking and KMS; (c) Regulated/high-compliance: Private deployment (VPC/on-prem). Add fallback routing to a lower-cost model variant.
Jordan (Security): Also include an ask: GreenMarket needs SSO + SCIM and at-rest encryption with customer KMS for production. Mark that as "must-have" for Dedicated/Private.
Sam (AE): Timeline suggestion: Week 0: contract and SSO + legal checklist. Week1: onboarding + model selection + ingest sample prompts (we ask for 1k labeled examples). Week2-3: eval runs + quality tuning. Week4: perf tuning + dedicated capacity bench (if chosen). Week5: acceptance and go/no-go.
Rita (Solutions): Action items — I can own eval harness and prompt set collection. Jordan can own questionnaire answers. Morgan to spin up hosted test in eu-west for quick latency bench. Sam to confirm pricing ballpark and commit options. Alex to draft the hosting decision 1-pager.
ops-bot: New request submitted — Dedicated capacity assessment ticket #DM-1249 created (owners: Morgan, Ops Infra).
Alex: Meeting to sync on Monday 09:30 CET to review the 1-pager and agree the POC acceptance criteria. Please add any remaining blockers in-thread. :calendar:
